title: The Business Case & Legal Landscape Revisited 💼
description: Deepen your understanding of ROI, global laws, VPATs, and how to make accessibility a strategic priority.

slides.title: Why Accessibility Is a Business Imperative 📈
slides.content:
Beyond compliance, accessibility drives tangible business value:

- **Market expansion**: over 1.3 billion people globally have a disability – a huge untapped market.
- **SEO**: semantic HTML and alt text boost search rankings.
- **Innovation**: designing for constraints leads to better products (curb‑cut effect).
- **Brand reputation**: inclusive companies are seen as ethical and trustworthy.
- **Risk mitigation**: avoid costly lawsuits and negative PR.

Accessibility is not a cost centre – it's a growth strategy.

slides.title: The Global Legal Landscape ⚖️
slides.content:
Key regulations worldwide:

- **ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act)** – US, applies to websites as places of public accommodation. Title II (public entities) and III (businesses).
- **Section 508** – US federal agencies must comply with WCAG 2.0 AA (updated to 2.1).
- **EAA (European Accessibility Act)** – requires products/services in EU to be accessible by 2025.
- **AODA (Ontario, Canada)** – all websites must meet WCAG 2.0 AA.
- **UK Equality Act 2010** – service providers must not discriminate, often tested via WCAG.

Non‑compliance can lead to lawsuits, fines, and forced remediation.

quizData.question: What standard does the European Accessibility Act (EAA) essentially enforce?

options.text: WCAG 2.1 AA for a wide range of products and services

quizData.explanation: The EAA will apply to many private sector products and services, requiring WCAG conformance.

slides.title: VPATs & Procurement 📋
slides.content:
A **VPAT** (Voluntary Product Accessibility Template) documents how a product meets accessibility standards.

- Required in many government contracts (US Section 508).
- Typically covers WCAG, 508, and EN 301 549.
- Buyers use VPATs to compare product accessibility.

If your organization sells software, a VPAT is a competitive advantage. Keep it honest – false claims can lead to legal trouble.

quizData.question: What does VPAT stand for?
quizData.explanation: VPAT is the standard template for reporting accessibility conformance.

slides.title: The ROI of Accessibility 💰
slides.content:
Calculating ROI:

- **Revenue increase**: reaching more customers.
- **Cost avoidance**: fewer lawsuits (settlements often $10k‑$50k+).
- **Operational efficiency**: reduced support calls, better code quality.
- **Talent retention**: employees with disabilities can stay productive.

Frame accessibility as an investment, not an expense. A case study: a major retailer increased revenue by $13M after fixing accessibility issues.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Build a business case deck
Tailor it to your stakeholders: legal, marketing, engineering. Use real lawsuit examples and market size data.
